ticket.title: Lifecycle transitions: no verb parks an existing ticket or reopens a verified one, so a held epic cannot be held down
ticket.description: Discovered 2026-11-10 while planning the backlog burn-down. Deferred is reachable only at creation: ops/graph.rs:88-91 maps a defer of a non-bug/tech_debt/chore kind straight to Deferred, and nothing else in the tree ever writes that status. Consequences measured on the live board the same day: GB-155 carries an owner do-not-start directive yet still reads Ready, and storypole next recommends it as the next task; SP-40 reads Ready although its only remaining deliverable is MTR-1, which sits Deferred in another repository, so even the blocked_by edge that would say so cannot be recorded against a parked task. GB-341 records the mirror-image half, a Verified task that cannot be reopened. Wanted: one transition verb with explicit legality rules - park a task into Deferred, return it to Ready, and reopen a Verified task while retaining the previous receipt for audit - recorded as its own ledger event kind so replay stays deterministic, and refusing transitions that would hide work. Acceptance: park GB-155 and storypole list stops offering it, unpark returns it to Ready with its priority intact, reopen preserves the prior receipt, and a ledger replay reproduces every transition in order.
